note: Conformance vectors for ADR 0154's node plans and core's own rights over a node: each kind's header order (`kinds`), a node header's plan (`header`: the rights its page and core grant, the kind's order, the page's own entries and, on an app, how many buttons fit (`maxButtons`, absent: all) -> buttons, the menu, the menu's last group), a level row's menu (`row`: rights and own entries -> the menu and its last group), and core's favourite, cover and bookmark rights (`rights`, every combination of their inputs). Entries are `HeaderAction`'s serial names. Each case names its rule (`rule`). Inputs chosen by hand; every `expected` first recorded from the web's TypeScript, where it can express the case, and read against its rule before commit. A level's plan (`level`): New's entries where they are offered (`creates`: a member's level or the drawer, the kept link where the platform draws its dialog; `guest`: a link guest's level by its role), in the web's order (`LevelView.vue`'s folder first, then the registry's `levelMenu` by `order`), and the level's tools (`tools`: Select where the level's rows allow a selection's action (`select`, the web's `canSelect`), the trash where offered, the view switch only where the level offers more than one view, the web's `showViews`). Entries of `creates` and `guest` are `AppKinds.Create`'s names, of `tools` `LevelTool`'s serial names. A level's selection (`selection`, inbox #1049): each row's rights (`rows`: whether it moves, copies, is reported and deleted with the selection), the selected ids and the ids the tab on screen shows -> whether Select is offered, how many of the level are selected, how many of them the tab hides, and the bar's entries in order (an action shown where some row allows it, `enabled` where some selected row does, `cannot` how many selected it does not reach; `SelectionAction`'s serial names): the web's `selectionBar` and the core's `LevelSelection.bar`.

header.rule: a member's folder: core's around the standard ones, in the kind's order
a Memory: its page's upload, banner and music among them; the banner in the last group
a Memory whose banner is drawn already: no banner entry
a file: its replace beside the share
a kept link that reads: its own page first, its name's report then its share's, the delete last
a kept link whose link does not read: its name's report alone
a kept link on an instance that takes no report: its share's report still
a READ guest's folder: the download and the report
a READ_WRITE guest's folder: the move too
a space pending deletion: what reads, and the share (listing links is a read)
a space's top level: no node, no order
an order lists the actions it names first, every other one follows in the merge order
an app's folder: rename, cover and "Available offline" in the menu, two buttons fit
a phone's file: send in the menu, three buttons fit
no button fits: every one in the menu, in order, the last group apart

row.rule: a folder's row: rename and move first, core's after the heart and the cover, report and delete last
a kept link's row that reads: its share's report after its name's
a READ_WRITE guest's row: the move, the download, the report
a row's share among the standard ones (owner 2026-11-22: on every client)
an app's row of a node kept offline

creates.rule: a member's level: the web's order, the folder first, the uploads after the Memory, the Pot and the kept link last
a member's level on a platform that draws no kept link's dialog
the drawer's New without the kept link

guest.rule: a READ_WRITE guest's folder: a folder, files and a folder uploaded (owner 2026-11-22)
a READ_WRITE guest in a guest's identity folder: nothing
a WRITE_ONLY guest has no level

tools.rule: a member's level whose rows allow a selection's action: Select first, then the trash and the view switch
a member's level: the trash, then the view switch
an empty level outside a guest's identity folder still switches its view
an empty guest's identity folder offers one view at most: no switch
a guest's identity folder with rows switches its view
the Memories map tab shows no list: no switch

selection.rule: a member's level: every action shown and enabled for what is selected
nothing selected yet: every action the level allows shown, none enabled
a guest's folder among the selection is not deleted as a node: the delete says one of two it cannot reach
every selected row refuses the delete: shown (another row allows it) but not enabled
a READ guest's level: the report only, which names no row it cannot reach
a selected row the report does not reach: the report, unlike the others, says nothing it cannot reach
no row allows anything (offline, the report not published): no Select
a kind this build does not copy: no copy where no row copies
the tab hides a selected row: counted, and said as hidden
a selected node that left the level counts nowhere
